description: This file defines an interface ModelConditionFactory for creating ModelCondition instances based on XML elements, serving as a factory pattern within the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model package.

classes.name: ModelConditionFactory
classes.description: An interface that declares a method to create ModelCondition objects from XML elements and a ModelWidget context.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ModelCondition based on the provided ModelWidget and XML element, throwing IllegalArgumentException if no suitable model is found.
